title: Playlist Dedupe
summary: A streaming app shows the same song twice in playlists. Fix song matching, then rank artists by listeners and compare playlists, fast enough for a busy day of plays.
followUps: Why did the normaliser compile and run without complaint while doing nothing to the case?
Which other String methods have the same trap, and how would you spot it in review?
What is the cost of similarity for playlists of n and m tracks, and of topArtists for p plays?
Users want 'Live' versions treated as different songs but 'Remastered' ones as the same. Where does that rule live, and how would you test it?
What did the assistant get wrong or leave out, and how did you notice?
